evidence_type: designed synthetic workloads plus small real-data feasibility audit
primary_metric: mean shortfall of worst ceil(10% of users) among users with >=5 test sessions
primary_comparator: validation-selected among equal, maxmin, debt_share, pf_mpc
selection_rule: lowest validation worst-tail subject to >=98% equal delivery and <=103% equal cost/kWh; if none, smallest delivery deficit then tail
history_initialization: 0 per policy per split; updates once after departure
uncertainty: paired Student-t intervals across five independent generated user populations; conditional paired 5-day outcome-block bootstrap sensitivity
control_information: observed arrivals, requests, energy, completed policy-specific history; fixed training model; no future arrivals or departures
deviations_from_prd: exact marginal survival expectation replaces scenario sampling for a common-plan linear objective
five independent workload seeds replace scenario seeds
simulation study required because accessible empirical repeated-user gate failed
75/20/15/30 working-day chronological split prioritizes held-out repeat-user coverage
